cli.usage:
Whydah salvages video, audio and photos from the web.

Usage:
  whydah                         open the UI in your browser
  whydah salvage [flags] URL...  download everything at each link (or just: whydah URL...)
  whydah spyglass URL...         show what each link has, without downloading
  whydah refit                   update the helper tools to their latest releases
  whydah update                  update Whydah itself to its latest release
  whydah sign-in [URL]           open Whydah's own browser to sign in to sites (at URL)

Flags:
error.setup: Whydah couldn't set up its helpers.
error.setup_ytdlp: Whydah couldn't get yt-dlp, which it needs to download anything. Check your internet connection, then start Whydah again.
setup.no_ffmpeg: ffmpeg isn't available, so audio conversion and high-quality video merging are off.
setup.no_deno: deno isn't available, so some sites' formats may be missing.
setup.no_gallery_dl: gallery-dl isn't available, so photos are found by scanning the page only, which misses galleries only gallery-dl knows how to read.
setup.system_ytdlp: Using the yt-dlp installed at {path}, which may be out of date.
ui.update_may_fix: Newer tools are available and may fix this.
ui.refit_waiting: Refitting once the current downloads finish…
ui.refit_may_work: Downloads that failed before may work now.
ui.update_available: Newer tools are available ({pending}). Sites change often, and a refit fixes downloads that stop working.
ui.no_token: This page needs to be opened from the app. Run Whydah again to get a working link.
cli.flag_linked: CLI: check the videos a page's thumbnails link to (spyglass lists them, salvage downloads them)
cli.flag_crows_nest: CLI: find photos by loading each page in a hidden browser, for pages built by scripts
cli.flag_output: download folder (overrides settings for this run)
cli.flag_browser: use cookies from this browser for this run (chrome, firefox, safari, ..., or whydah for Whydah's sign-in browser)
cli.flag_port: UI port (falls back to a random port if busy)
cli.flag_no_browser: don't open the UI in a browser
cli.needs_link: whydah {command} needs at least one link
cli.signin_one_link: whydah sign-in takes at most one link
cli.signin_handed: Opened the sign-in window of the Whydah that's running. Close it when you're done.
cli.refit_running: Whydah is running; use Refit in its window, or quit it first.
cli.keep_open: Keep this window open while downloading. Press Ctrl+C (or Quit in the UI) to stop.
cli.no_browser_open: Couldn't open a browser automatically; open the link above.
